source_of_truth: Roadmap doc docs/roadmap-2026-05-19-install-ux-architecture-v0.md v1.2 §Plan 2 + operator review constraints captured in this plan's child_charter.forbidden_decisions + D001. First-touch authority for a new user — the doctor is the surface that catches the three first-user blockers (GitHub PAT, Python version, codex CLI) before a paid volley fails.

user_journeys.name: new-user-runs-doctor-on-fresh-clone
user_journeys.description: A new user clones DontPanic and runs `dontpanic doctor --profile=core --json`. The doctor surfaces the three first-user blockers (GitHub auth missing, Python <3.10, codex CLI not installed) with copy-paste fix commands, in <=10s wall clock. No Firebase or agent-conventions probes appear under --profile=core.
acceptance_signals: All three first-user blockers appear in --profile=core output
Each blocker has a fix_url AND a fix_command
Firebase/gcloud/agent-conventions probes are absent from --profile=core
Full sweep wall clock <=10s
JSON output schema is stable

user_journeys.name: agent-installer-uses-json-mode
user_journeys.description: An agent installer (e.g. a wrapper script or CI provisioner) runs `dontpanic doctor --json --profile=ci` and parses the structured output to decide what to install. The JSON schema is stable and version-pinned. Exit code 0=ready, 1=warnings, 2=blockers — the agent can branch on the code without parsing text.
acceptance_signals: JSON schema is documented + snapshot-tested for stability
Exit codes match the 0/1/2 matrix on every probe outcome
--profile=<unknown> errors with the valid profile list
No interactive prompts in --json path

user_journeys.name: first-touch-init-walkthrough
user_journeys.description: A new user runs `dontpanic init` after `dontpanic doctor` flagged red items. Init walks the checklist: for each red probe, it shows why_needed + fix_command and (where auto_install_safe=True) offers to run the fix. The user resolves blockers in order without leaving the terminal. After all probes pass, init runs `dontpanic smoke` to confirm dispatch_volley actually works.
acceptance_signals: init is idempotent (re-runnable mid-install without state file)
--non-interactive mode exits 1 with JSON listing red probes
--auto-fix-safe executes only auto_install_safe=True probes; falls through for unsafe
Smoke runs automatically as init's final step when all probes pass
Smoke env-blocker exit re-enters the fix loop

user_journeys.name: smoke-catches-blockers-without-paid-call
user_journeys.description: A new user (or CI) runs `dontpanic smoke` after install. The synthetic plan + mocked executors exercise supervisor.dispatch_volley end-to-end without any paid API calls. Missing claude CLI or missing codex CLI short-circuits with exit code 2 + the prereq fix_url. Real supervisor defects exit code 1. Bounded <=30s wall clock.
acceptance_signals: No paid API calls (no anthropic / openrouter network)
Wall clock <=30s
tmpdir cleaned up on success AND on exception
Exit codes: 0=pass, 1=real defect, 2=env blocker
Every supervisor branch a real run hits is exercised by the mock path

user_journeys.name: operator-shares-install-report
user_journeys.description: An operator helping a community user runs `dontpanic init --report` and shares the resulting docs/install-report.html. The report opens cleanly in Chrome/Safari/Firefox on macOS + Linux, shows per-probe status badges, the highest-priority red item with a copy-paste fix, and footer links to README + Hermes cheat sheet. The HTML is gitignored — no noisy diffs in PR review.
acceptance_signals: HTML is single-page, no JS framework, no external CSS, no external fonts
Mobile-responsive (single column <800px, two-column wider)
All operator-facing output is html.escape'd (no injection)
docs/install-report.html in .gitignore
Generated HTML is well-formed HTML5

non_goals: No auto-creation of GitHub PATs (operator decision — too sensitive; copy-paste only)
No auto-generation of Firebase SA keys (bootstrap.sh handles --create-key flow)
No Windows support in v0 (macOS + Linux only; document the gap, don't probe)
No reusable profile authoring UX (operator-defined custom profiles deferred to v1)
No README rewrite for first-time visitor (Roadmap defers to after F001 delta assessment)
No installing dependencies outside safe scopes (no sudo, no system-Python, no pipx --force, no global brew without per-probe auto_install_safe=true)
out_of_scope_for_v0: Maintainer profile + agent-conventions remote probes (Roadmap Plan 5/7)
